comment: Grafo di progressione. `satisfiedWhen` usa il vocabolario dei criteri del verifier; un milestone senza satisfiedWhen è soddisfatto solo se il controller ha già verificato la skill (completed set). Vedi docs/SURVIVAL-INTELLIGENCE.md.

wood.description: Collect logs for planks, sticks and tools.

crafting_table.description: Craft and place a crafting table.

stone_tools.description: Mine stone and craft stone tools.

food_and_safety.description: Have usable food before the first night.

first_night.description: Survive the first night and be alive at dawn.

iron_age.description: Mine and smelt iron and reach iron tools.

diamonds.description: Mine diamonds with an iron pickaxe or better.

nether_portal.description: Locate a nearby Nether portal, or gather obsidian and build one.

enter_nether.description: Light the portal and step through into the Nether.

nether_survival.description: Survive in the Nether: avoid fire/lava, ghast fireballs and enderman gazes, and keep health.

piglin_barter.description: Barter gold ingots with piglins for Nether loot.

obtain_blaze_rods.description: Find a Nether fortress and collect blaze rods from blazes.

obtain_ender_pearls.description: Collect ender pearls (piglin bartering or gazeless enderman kills).

craft_eyes_of_ender.description: Craft eyes of ender from blaze powder and ender pearls.

find_stronghold.description: Throw eyes of ender to locate a stronghold and reach its portal room.

enter_end.description: Fill the End portal frames and step into the End.

beat_the_dragon.description: Destroy the end crystals and defeat the Ender Dragon.
